scope: Recorded hourly zero-cost full-engine and separately labelled native-component replay

contract.name: prior-close-decision_next-close-fill_long-flat_v1
contract.sizing: All affordable continuous units on entry; hold units until exit; no ongoing rebalancing
contract.signal_availability: Decision uses only the prefix through close[t]; earliest fill is close[t+1]
contract.fee_basis: fee_bps/10000 times actual fill price times absolute executed quantity
contract.equity_observation: Cash plus units marked at the unadjusted close, after the close fill
contract.held_observation: Incoming held state over the interval ending at the current close, before its fill
contract.terminal_rule: Predeclared liquidation at penultimate real close; final real row settles delayed bookkeeping
